name: play_by_play
description: Event-level play-by-play: one row per play (shot/foul/turnover/rebound/etc.) for every game, with shot coordinates, the players involved, and game-clock context. ESPN-sourced (hoopR::load_nba_pbp()) since the NBA-Stats-native PBP/shot-location endpoints are currently blocked on NBA's side. game_id_nba is bridged in deterministically by matching (game_date, home team abbrev, away team abbrev) against the schedule - not ESPN's native game_id (kept as game_id_espn). ~99.9% of games match; the rare miss is an All-Star/exhibition game with no NBA Stats counterpart.

name: game_play_number
description: This play's ordinal position within the game (1st play, 2nd play, ...).

name: id
description: ESPN's unique identifier for this individual play event.

name: sequence_number
description: ESPN's sequence number for this play within the game feed.

name: type_id
description: ESPN's numeric code for this play's event type.

name: type_text
description: Event type in plain text, e.g. 'Jump Shot', 'Defensive Rebound', 'Clear Path Foul', '8-Second Turnover'. Very granular - dozens of distinct foul/turnover/shot subtypes.

name: text
description: Full human-readable play description, e.g. 'Chet Holmgren makes 1-foot layup (Luguentz Dort assists)'.

name: away_score
description: Away team's running score after this play.
leakage_risk: safe (this play's own outcome, not a prediction target)

name: home_score
description: Home team's running score after this play.
leakage_risk: safe (this play's own outcome, not a prediction target)

name: period_number
description: Quarter/period number.

name: period_display_value
description: Human-readable period, e.g. '1st Quarter', 'OT'.

name: clock_display_value
description: Alias of time.

name: scoring_play
description: TRUE if this play scored points.

name: score_value
description: Points this play was worth (1/2/3), NA if not a scoring play.

name: team_id
description: ESPN's own team identifier for the team involved in this play - NOT our NBA Stats team_id used elsewhere in this pipeline.

name: athlete_id_1
description: ESPN's player identifier for the primary player involved in this play (e.g. the shooter) - NOT our NBA Stats player_id.

name: athlete_id_2
description: ESPN's player identifier for a secondary player involved (e.g. the assister), if any.

name: athlete_id_3
description: ESPN's player identifier for a third player involved, if any.

name: wallclock
description: Real-world UTC timestamp the play was recorded.

name: shooting_play
description: TRUE if this play was a shot attempt (made or missed).

name: coordinate_x_raw
description: Shot/event x-coordinate in ESPN's raw pixel-space units.

name: coordinate_y_raw
description: Shot/event y-coordinate in ESPN's raw pixel-space units.

name: game_id_espn
description: ESPN's own game identifier (this data's native key before bridging to game_id_nba).

name: season_type
description: 'Regular Season' / 'Playoffs' / etc. for this game.

name: home_team_id
description: ESPN's own identifier for the home team - NOT our NBA Stats team_id.

name: home_team_name
description: Home team's name as ESPN spells it.

name: home_team_mascot
description: Home team's mascot name.

name: home_team_abbrev
description: Home team's abbreviation as ESPN spells it - differs from our home_team_tricode for 6 franchises (NY/GS/SA/UTAH/WSH/NO vs our NYK/GSW/SAS/UTA/WAS/NOP); used to build the game_id_nba bridge (see R/pull_playbyplay.R).

name: home_team_name_alt
description: Alternate/short form of the home team's name.

name: away_team_id
description: ESPN's own identifier for the away team - NOT our NBA Stats team_id.

name: away_team_name
description: Away team's name as ESPN spells it.

name: away_team_mascot
description: Away team's mascot name.

name: away_team_abbrev
description: Away team's abbreviation as ESPN spells it - same mismatch caveat as home_team_abbrev.

name: away_team_name_alt
description: Alternate/short form of the away team's name.

name: game_spread
description: Betting point spread for this game, as carried by ESPN's feed - not something this pipeline pulled deliberately; unrelated to the bigballsdata odds work (R/pull_bigballsdata_odds.R). Review before relying on it (coverage/definition not verified).

name: home_favorite
description: Whether the home team was favored, per ESPN's feed. Same caveat as game_spread - not independently verified.

name: game_spread_available
description: Whether a spread was available for this game in ESPN's feed.

name: home_team_spread
description: Home team's point spread, per ESPN's feed. Same caveat as game_spread.

name: qtr
description: Quarter number (5+ = overtime period).

name: time
description: Game clock display at this play, e.g. '11:36'.

name: clock_minutes
description: Minutes remaining on the game clock at this play.

name: clock_seconds
description: Seconds remaining on the game clock at this play.

name: home_timeout_called
description: TRUE if the home team called a timeout on this play.

name: away_timeout_called
description: TRUE if the away team called a timeout on this play.

name: half
description: Half number (1 or 2).

name: game_half
description: Alias/label of half.

name: lag_qtr
description: Quarter number of the previous play - a lookback helper for detecting quarter transitions.

name: lead_qtr
description: Quarter number of the next play - a lookahead helper for detecting quarter transitions.

name: lag_half
description: Half number of the previous play.

name: lead_half
description: Half number of the next play.

name: start_quarter_seconds_remaining
description: Seconds remaining in the quarter at the start of this play.

name: start_half_seconds_remaining
description: Seconds remaining in the half at the start of this play.

name: start_game_seconds_remaining
description: Seconds remaining in the game at the start of this play.

name: end_quarter_seconds_remaining
description: Seconds remaining in the quarter after this play.

name: end_half_seconds_remaining
description: Seconds remaining in the half after this play.

name: end_game_seconds_remaining
description: Seconds remaining in the game after this play.

name: period
description: Alias of qtr/period_number.

name: coordinate_x
description: Shot/event x-coordinate, normalized to real court units - use this (not the _raw version) for zone/distance calculations.

name: coordinate_y
description: Shot/event y-coordinate, normalized to real court units - use this (not the _raw version) for zone/distance calculations.

name: game_date
description: Calendar date the game was/will be played.

name: game_date_time
description: Full game start timestamp.

name: athlete_name_1
description: Name of the primary player involved in this play.

name: athlete_name_2
description: Name of a secondary player involved, if any.

name: athlete_name_3
description: Name of a third player involved, if any.

name: type_abbreviation
description: Short code for type_text.

name: game_id_nba
description: NBA Stats API's canonical game identifier, bridged in from the schedule (not ESPN's native key).
logic: Joined from schedule on (game_date, home team abbrev, away team abbrev) - a deterministic key, since a team plays a given opponent at most once per date. ~99.9% match rate; the rare miss is typically an All-Star/exhibition game with no NBA Stats regular-season/playoff counterpart.

name: season
description: Season string, e.g. '2022-23'.
logic: Set explicitly to the season being pulled, not trusted from the API's own inconsistently-typed season field - see R/pull_schedule.R.
